description: Threlfall has put you on gauge duty, which isn't a favour and not a test in any way she would admit to. Walk out to the gauge house, wind the drum, check the chart against the board, and come back. Twice a day is the rent this place pays for a lake that doesn't need it. Doing it once is how they find out whether you turn up.
name: The Rent

objectives.desc: Walk out to the gauge house on the far shoulder of the dam and wind the drum.
emotes: {who} winds the cord back onto the drum and squints at the pen line.
{who} finds the drum stiff for the first half turn and easier after, the way it's described on the card.
{who} copies the figure onto the chart in the box provided, and not in the margin.

objectives.desc: Report the reading back at the tally.
emotes: {who} reads the figure off without being asked twice.
{who} gets back inside the hour, which nobody comments on and everybody notices.
